archimate:ApplicationService.name: Care Team Collaboration Service
archimate:ApplicationService.documentation:
A Care Team Collaboration Service is a secure communication and shared workspace platform that enables multidisciplinary healthcare providers to chat, share real-time clinical updates, and collectively coordinate patient care plans.
Its purpose is to break down clinical communication silos and facilitate immediate team-based decision-making, ensuring that every specialist, nurse, and therapist involved in a patient's care is aligned on the active treatment strategy.
Example: A patient's care team—consisting of an attending physician, a physical therapist, and a clinical pharmacist—uses this service to co-design and approve a personalized post-stroke rehabilitation plan in a unified, secure messaging thread.
